_meta.adr: ADR-037 fragment — declarative WMO (Wet Markt en Overheid, Mededingingswet ch. 4b) compliance: CommercialActivity, IntegralCostPrice, ActivityCostAllocation, AlgemeenBelangBesluit, ACMReport, AlertLog (cross-subsidy detector), WMOAuditLog (immutable), MarketBenchmark. Merged additively into shillinq_register.json at load (SettingsService::deepMergeConfig).
_meta.description: Phase 1+2 WMO compliance engine. Declares 8 schemas plus their x-openregister-lifecycle, x-openregister-relations, x-openregister-aggregations and x-openregister-rbac blocks. Per-period IKP records are immutable (status=voorlopig|definitief); ActivityCostAllocation splits are reversible audit records; ACMReport is write-once after digital signature; WMOAuditLog has 7-year retention per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

CommercialActivity.title: Commercial Activity
CommercialActivity.description: Per-bestuursorgaan commercial activity register (REQ-WMO-001). First-class record (not a free-form GL tag) so ACM meldingstatus, ABB exemption, kostprijsmethode, kostenplaats/kostendrager coupling, marktcontext and audit trail attach declaratively. An annual review-task is auto-generated when lastReviewedAt is > 365 days old (REQ-WMO-001 §c).

code.description: Operator-assigned activity code, unique per administration (REQ-WMO-001).

bestuursorgaan.description: Bestuursorgaan responsible for the activity (gemeente / provincie / waterschap / GR / RUD).

beschrijving.description: Description of goods/services offered on market.

startDatum.description: Effective start date of the commercial activity.

eindDatum.description: Closure date if the activity has ended.

kostprijsMethode.description: Cost-price method. integrale-kostprijs-art-25i is the default; the monitor variant is only valid for ABB-exempted activities.

isExempted.description: True when exempted via an AlgemeenBelangBesluit.

jaaromzet.description: Last-known annual turnover in EUR (informational; not authoritative).

deelnemers.description: Multi-bestuursorgaan participants (REQ-WMO-011, Phase 3). Empty for single-deelnemer activities.

aandeelPercentage.description: Deelnemer share percentage (sum across deelnemers SHOULD equal 100).

exemptionBesluitId.description: Per-deelnemer ABB FK; null for non-exempted deelnemers.

lastReviewedAt.description: Timestamp of last annual compliance review (REQ-WMO-001 §c).

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning the activity.

state.description: Activity state. closed is set when eindDatum is recorded; records are never deleted.

retention.description: WMO records retained 7 years per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

active.label: Active
active.description: Operating commercial activity. IKP calc + transaction splits + alerts apply.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Temporarily inactive; IKP calc skipped but record remains for audit.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Activity ended (eindDatum recorded). Historical reporting only.

exemptionBesluit.description: The ABB granting exemption when isExempted=true (REQ-WMO-005).

integralCostPrices.description: All IKP records for this activity (REQ-WMO-002).

alerts.description: Cross-subsidy alerts raised against this activity (REQ-WMO-007).

lastIntegralCostPricePeriod.description: Most-recent IKP period (REQ-WMO-002). Drives the cross-subsidy 'omzet spike without IKP update' alert.

totalManualOverrides.description: Cumulative count of handmatige overrides for this activity, used by REQ-WMO-007 detector scenario 5.

wmo-annual-review-detector.name: Annual review-task generator
wmo-annual-review-detector.description: Daily walker over all active CommercialActivity records. Emits a 'wmo-annual-review' task whenever lastReviewedAt is > 365 days old (REQ-WMO-001 §c). Composed by CommercialActivityReviewService and dispatched via the Nextcloud notification + IJobList task surface.

wmo-cross-subsidy-detector.name: Cross-subsidy detector
wmo-cross-subsidy-detector.description: Monthly walker per CommercialActivity, evaluating the 6 REQ-WMO-007 cross-subsidy risk scenarios (loss-financing, omzet-spike-no-IKP-update, overhead-under-allocation, ABB-stale, manual-override-accumulation, potentiele-overhead-onderschatting) plus the REQ-WMO-012 Phase-3 bevoordeling-risk scenario. Emits AlertLog records via CrossSubsidyDetector for any match. Runs the 1st of the month at 02:00 UTC.

IntegralCostPrice.title: Integral Cost Price
IntegralCostPrice.description: Time-versioned integrale-kostprijs (IKP) record per commercial activity per period (REQ-WMO-002). Monthly records are status=voorlopig; the year-end roll-up is signed off as status=definitief on 31 March of the following year. Records are immutable after creation; restatements create a new periode-restatement record rather than mutating prior values.

periode.description: Period identifier YYYY-MM (monthly), YYYY-Qn (quarterly) or YYYY-YTD (annual).

status.description: voorlopig = monthly provisional; definitief = year-end accountant-signed lock; voorlopig-transitie = first IKP after activity transition (Phase 3).

componenten.description: Component breakdown of integrale kostprijs in EUR (REQ-WMO-002).

directeLoonkosten.description: Direct labour costs from GL accounts tagged with the activity's kostenplaatsCode.

directeMaterialen.description: Direct materials costs from the activity's GL lines.

directeAfschrijvingen.description: Direct depreciation costs (FixedAsset.monthlyDepreciation × period) for assets dedicated to the activity.

indirecteOverhead.description: Indirect overhead allocated via the geldende OverheadDistributionRule (BBV taakveld 0.4 sleutel). Sub-keys are buckets (huisvesting, ict, directieEnStaf, facilitair, plus operator-custom).

vermogenskosten.description: Capital cost via WACC (default 4.5%, configurable per administration) on the activity's invested book value.

winstopslag.description: Profit mark-up (default 2-5%, configurable per activity and per period).

totaleKosten.description: Sum of all components in EUR.

gehanteerdTarief.description: Actual price charged per unit (Art. 25i compliance check input).

marge.description: gehanteerdTarief - kostprijsPerEenheid (or totaleKosten when no units).

compliant.description: True when gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid (or totaleKosten if no units).

definitiefSignedBy.description: Nextcloud user-id of accountant who signed off on a definitief record (REQ-WMO-002 §year-end lock).

definitiefSignedAt.description: Timestamp of the year-end definitief sign-off.

commercialActivity.description: The activity this IKP belongs to.

wmo-ikp-monthly-calculation.name: Monthly IKP calculation
wmo-ikp-monthly-calculation.description: Monthly calculation of IntegralCostPrice voorlopig per active CommercialActivity (REQ-WMO-002). Pulls GL lines tagged with the activity's kostenplaats / kostendrager, applies the geldende OverheadDistributionRule (BBV taakveld 0.4 sleutel), the WACC vermogenskosten rate, and the per-period winstopslag. Persists one IKP record per (commercialActivityId, periode). Runs the 1st of the month at 03:00 UTC.

wmo-ikp-year-end-lock.name: Year-end IKP definitief lock
wmo-ikp-year-end-lock.description: On 31 March of the following fiscal year, aggregates all monthly voorlopig IKP records for the closed FY into a single definitief IKP-YTD record, locked by accountant digital signature (REQ-WMO-002 §year-end lock).

ActivityCostAllocation.title: Activity Cost Allocation
ActivityCostAllocation.description: Immutable, reversible split record (REQ-WMO-003). A JournalEntry posted on a GL account linked to a CommercialActivity (via kostenplaats/kostendrager) triggers an automatic split using the geldende OverheadDistributionRule for the posting date. Handmatige overrides require 4-ogen-akkoord (two approver ids) and a motivering; the original record is marked status=overridden and a new record replaces it.

journalEntryId.description: FK to the JournalEntry / GLTransaction being split (REQ-WMO-003).

commercialActivityId.description: FK to the CommercialActivity matched on kostenplaats/kostendrager.

glLineId.description: FK to the specific GLLine within the journal entry (when a line-level match).

originalAmount.description: Total transaction amount being split (EUR; can be negative for credit memos).

splits.description: Split lines; sum of amounts equals originalAmount.

kostendrager.description: Destination kostendrager code (e.g. D-PUBL-NM-100 or D-MO-NM-001).

amount.description: Calculated EUR amount (originalAmount × ratio, rounded to cents).

grootboek.description: Optional materialised GL account number when the operator runs 'post splits to ledger' mode.

dimensie.description: Sub-administratie dimension. PUBL = publieke; MO = markt/commerciële.

verdeelsleutel.description: FK to OverheadDistributionRule.id used for this split.

automatischToegepast.description: True for automatic split via the splitter; false for handmatige overrides.

handmatigeOverride.description: Override record when automatischToegepast=false. Requires 2-eye sign-off (REQ-WMO-003 §override).

approvedBy.description: Exactly two Nextcloud user-ids that approved the override.

replacesId.description: FK to the original (now status=overridden) ActivityCostAllocation.

postingDate.description: Posting date of the source journal entry — drives geldende-OverheadDistributionRule selection.

materialised.description: True when the split was posted to the ledger as balanced GL lines (REQ-WMO-003 §materialise mode).

status.description: Lifecycle. overridden = a newer ActivityCostAllocation replaces it; reversed = source journal entry was reversed.

retention.description: ActivityCostAllocation records retained 7 years per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

overridden.label: Overridden
overridden.description: Superseded by a handmatige override; preserved for audit trail.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Source journal entry reversed; allocation no longer in effect.

overheadRule.description: The OverheadDistributionRule applied for this split.

journal-entry-posted.name: Activity cost allocation splitter
journal-entry-posted.description: On JournalEntry.created / .transitioned to status=posted, resolve the geldende OverheadDistributionRule for the posting date, match the CommercialActivity by kostenplaats/kostendrager, and persist an ActivityCostAllocation record carrying the PUBL / MO splits (REQ-WMO-003). Materialise mode (post splits as additional balanced GL lines) is operator-configurable per administration.

AlgemeenBelangBesluit.title: Public Interest Decision
AlgemeenBelangBesluit.description: AlgemeenBelangBesluit (ABB) lifecycle record (REQ-WMO-005). Workflow: concept → raadsvoorstel → raadsbesluit → publicatie → acm-notified → bezwaar → geldig → evaluatie-due → herziening/intrekking. State transitions enforce preconditions (raadsbesluit requires kenmerk; geldig requires publicatieDatum + ACM-kenmerk). Automatic tasks are generated on raadsbesluit (publish gemeenteblad +14d), publicatie (notify ACM +7d), acm-notified (review bezwaarschriften +42d), and when volgendeEvaluatie is reached.

betreftActiviteiten.description: FK array of CommercialActivity.id records exempted by this ABB.

volgendeEvaluatie.description: Next scheduled evaluation date (auto-calculated from vaststellingsdatum + evaluatieRitme).

status.description: Workflow state. Geldig requires publicatieDatum + kennisgevingAcm.ingediend.

bezwaarTermijnVerstreken.description: True when the 6-week bezwaarschrift period has expired.

bestuursrechtelijkeProcedures.description: References to bezwaarschrift / administratief beroep records.

raadsBesluitId.description: Optional FK or freeform reference to bookkeeping-governance raads-besluit (Phase 3).

retention.description: ABB retained 7 years per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

activities.description: CommercialActivity records exempted by this ABB.

validateTransition.description: Validate ABB status transition preconditions (e.g. publicatie requires gemeenteblad + datum; geldig requires ACM kenmerk). Implemented by AbbLifecycleService::canTransition.

generateTasks.description: Emit the auto-generated task envelope (publish-gemeenteblad, notify-acm, review-bezwaarschriften, evaluate-abb) per REQ-WMO-005 §c.

verifyDrop.description: On publicatie, look up the gemeenteblad reference via the DROP API (openconnector OC-source) and write the verification envelope back onto dropVerification (REQ-WMO-005 §automatic verification). Fail-soft: an unavailable DROP API logs a verification record with success=false but does NOT block the transition.

flagDependentActivities.description: When an ABB enters intrekking or herziening, flag dependent CommercialActivity records (those whose exemptionBesluitId points at this ABB) for operator review (REQ-WMO-005 §dependents).

ACMReport.title: ACM Report
ACMReport.description: Quarterly / annual ACM rapportage in the official ACM-standaardformulier-mo-2024 format (REQ-WMO-006). Reports are write-once after the concerncontroller signs them off; submission flips status to verzonden and starts the 7-year retention countdown per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

samenvatting.description: Narrative summary appended to the report.

manualOverrides.description: Count of handmatige ActivityCostAllocation overrides during the period.

abbList.description: ABB-besluiten effective during the period (kenmerk + motivering excerpt).

ondertekenaar.description: Nextcloud user-id of the concerncontroller who signed.

verzondenAanAcm.description: True after submission to ACM (or generation of submission-ready package).

publicatieGemeenteblad.description: Optional gemeenteblad publication reference for the report itself.

status.description: Lifecycle. archived marks the 7-year-old immutable retention state.

retention.description: ACM rapportages retained 7 years per Mededingingswet.

signReport.description: On transition draft -> ready-for-submission, apply the concerncontroller's digital signature (NC certificate / PKI fingerprint) and write ondertekenaar + ondertekendOp + signatureFingerprint (REQ-WMO-006 §digital signature).

submitReport.description: On transition ready-for-submission -> verzonden, set verzondenAanAcm=true, optionally publish to gemeenteblad via openconnector, copy to write-once archive store, begin 7-year retention countdown (REQ-WMO-006 §submission + immutability).

jaarrekeningWiring.description: Wire annual ACM-rapport generation into the bookkeeping-financial-reporting T4 jaarrekening-generator: when an annual ACMReport (period ending in -YTD) is created, the financial-reporting export pipeline includes the WMO-bijlage produced by WmoJaarrekeningBijlageService (REQ-WMO-004 wiring, P1-15).

AlertLog.title: Cross-Subsidy Alert
AlertLog.description: Cross-subsidy detector alert (REQ-WMO-007). Generated monthly by the CrossSubsidyDetector ScheduledWorkflow for the 6 risk scenarios. Alerts default to assignedTo concerncontroller; if status=open for > 4 weeks the alert escalates to escalation-due assigned to gemeentesecretaris.

alertType.description: One of the 6 REQ-WMO-007 scenarios plus REQ-WMO-012 bevoordeling-risk (Phase 3).

resolutionNotes.description: Operator's motivation when marking reviewed-no-action / remediated.

wmo-alert-escalation.name: Cross-subsidy alert escalation
wmo-alert-escalation.description: Weekly walker over open AlertLog records. Any alert older than 4 weeks transitions status open -> escalation-due, is reassigned to gemeentesecretaris, and emits an escalation notification (REQ-WMO-007 §escalation).

resolveAlert.description: Validate resolution notes are non-empty and write the operator's motivation onto resolutionNotes (REQ-WMO-007 §resolution).

WMOAuditLog.title: WMO Audit Log
WMOAuditLog.description: Immutable audit-trail entry for any WMO entity-mutation (REQ-WMO-010). Append-only; entries are never updated except for the lifecycle transition to status=archived after the 7-year Mededingingswet bewaartermijn elapses. Sourced for the CSV export and the ACM handhavings-pakket.

beforeValues.description: JSON snapshot of the record before mutation (null for creates).

afterValues.description: JSON snapshot of the record after mutation (or alert/report payload for events without before-state).

reason.description: Motivation; verplicht for overrides, recommended otherwise.

status.description: archived after the 7-year retention boundary; entries may then be purged per archival policy.

retention.description: WMO audit log retained 7 years per Mededingingswet.

wmo-audit-log-retention-archival.name: WMO audit-log retention archival
wmo-audit-log-retention-archival.description: Daily walker over logged WMOAuditLog entries. Entries crossing the 7-year retention boundary transition status logged -> archived; entries may then be purged per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn (REQ-WMO-010 §retention).

MarketBenchmark.title: Market Benchmark
MarketBenchmark.description: Market-benchmark observation for tariff validation and Art. 25j bevoordeling-risk detection (REQ-WMO-012, Phase 3). The IKP calculation step retrieves benchmarks within last 12 months, computes a median, and raises a bevoordeling-risk alert when gehanteerdTarief < median × 0.85 despite gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid.

eenheid.description: Unit (must match IKP eenheidLabel for comparability).

concurrentNaam.description: Name of the competing provider (for offerte/prijslijst).

detectBevoordelingRisk.description: Phase 3 (REQ-WMO-012): when a MarketBenchmark is created, recompute the bevoordeling-risk for the linked CommercialActivity's most recent IKP. If gehanteerdTarief < benchmark median × 0.85 while gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid, emit a HIGH-severity bevoordeling-risk AlertLog (Art. 25j Mededingingswet).
